question: Simplify (3x + 2)² + (3x - 2)² .
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the direct algebraic identity: (a + b)² + (a − b)² = 2(a² + b²)

Here, a = 3x and b = 2.

⇒ 2 × ((3x)² + 2²)

⇒ 2 × (9x² + 4)

⇒ 18x² + 8

**∴ The correct answer is 18x² + 8.**
